purpose: Prevent runtime agents from treating unadmitted Markdown or prose declarations as canonical operational authority.

rules.rule: Runtime agents must query admitted canonical database state when available for governed authority questions.
If database authority resolution returns defer, agents must report the defer state and use the governed fallback hierarchy without treating Markdown as a competing operational SSOT.
Generated Markdown may be used for human-facing explanation only when projection metadata identifies canonical snapshot, object IDs, and validator run.
Human source, working notes, and historical records may guide proposals or audits but may not directly drive runtime authority.
Authority-deferred objects fail closed for promotion, demotion, proof elevation, evidence-class upgrade, and external-validity claims.
